interpretation_boundary: All candidate and tissue labels are model outputs rather than pathology ground truth.
HookNet, YOLO and PathPrism use the same H&E source; agreement is not independent biological validation.
Object-level observations are nested within slides and are not independent patients.
Grad-CAM, occlusion and blurred counterfactuals describe model dependence rather than biological causality.
No sensitivity, specificity, accuracy or clinical utility claim is supported.
